articles.title: Donald Trump says oil execs have made too much money since blockade of Hormuz Strait
articles.description: As a consequence of the Iran war and the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, oil prices have soared. The profits of the industry's biggest companies have also skyrocketed, and US President Donald Trump believes they're making far too much money. He's calling on them to lower prices. With the midterm elections just three months away, he's potentially concerned about growing anger among Americans. Story by Charlotte Hughes and France 2.

articles.title: Who is Abdul El-Sayed, Michigan Democrats' best hope at taking back the Senate?
articles.description: Abdul El-Sayed won the Michigan Democratic primary election to contest one of the state's two Senate seats. articles.title: DR Congo is set to open its largest ever Ebola treatment facility
articles.description: The DR Congo is set to open its largest Ebola treatment facility. Construction is nearing completion as health authorities race to contain an outbreak that the World Health Organization has described as intensifying at an "exceptional" pace. As of July 30, the WHO reported 3,605 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,587 deaths in the DR Congo. Officials hope the expanded treatment capacity will strengthen response efforts and improve care for patients as the outbreak continues to spread.

articles.title: Cameroon's president reshuffles military as speculation on whereabouts persists

articles.title: New round of talks about Israeli withdrawal from south of Lebanon
